title: Kamcheh — Construction Marketplace Beta
summary: A web marketplace experiment organized around construction specialists, work requests and evidence of completed projects.
role: Product strategy, information architecture and front-end prototyping
details: Kamcheh is an early-stage platform focused on construction execution rather than general home repair. The public website demonstrates the intended categories, specialist profiles and paths into a growing set of tools.
challenge: People commissioning construction work need more than a generic classified listing. They need a useful view of the specialist, the actual work and the surrounding project context.
approach: Organize the experience around specialists and work history first, keeping the product small enough to test how construction participants understand and use it.
highlights: Public marketplace website with sector-focused navigation
Specialist and project information arranged for practical discovery
An evolving beta rather than a claim of established market adoption
